To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the distributed meeting system provides a rich experience for both people who participate in a meeting and people who watch it later, and (2) people who participate in meetings using the system are more satisfied than people who participate in traditional meetings.

(1) people who attend a meeting in person are more satisfied than those who participate remotely; (2) people who participate remotely are less satisfied than those who watch a recording of the meeting; (3) people who watch a recording are more satisfied than people who miss the meeting; and (4) there are many differences in how people use the system, but no significant difference in overall satisfaction between the different groups.
the system provides a rich meeting experience to people who are unable to attend a meeting in person, and it also allows people who are unable attend to catch up with the meeting later.
